home.eyebrow: Organic cottage bakery in Shirley, Arkansas
home.headline: Mountain Whisk
home.tagline: A more mindful approach to indulgence.
home.intro: Cakes, cinnamon rolls, scones, cookies and breads baked from scratch with unbleached flour, raw sugar, grass-fed butter and dye-free ingredients. The menu follows the seasons.
home.ingredients_intro: Great baking starts with what you put in, and what you leave out.

ingredients.title: Unbleached flour
ingredients.text: Real flour the way it comes from the mill, with no bleaching agents.

ingredients.title: Raw sugar
ingredients.text: Less-refined sweetness with a hint of caramel.

ingredients.title: Grass-fed butter
ingredients.text: Rich, golden butter from grass-fed cows in every roll, scone and cookie.

ingredients.title: Dye-free
ingredients.text: No artificial dyes. Any color comes from real food.

home.bake_intro: Five things I love making, and the menu shifts with the seasons.
home.mission: Mountain Whisk is an “organic” cottage bakery dedicated to enhancing traditional baking methods by utilizing wholesome ingredients, including unbleached flour, raw sugar, grass-fed butter and dye-free products. A more mindful approach to indulgence.
home.story:
Everything is baked in small batches in a home kitchen in Shirley, Arkansas. The logo, a whisk rising over the mountains, was drawn by my brother, and it says it best: a love of the hills and a love of baking, rolled into one.

Offerings change with the seasons, so there's always something new to try.

celebrations.title: Weddings, stays & campgrounds
celebrations.intro: Bring a little Mountain Whisk to your celebration, your rental guests or your campsite. I'm now taking inquiries for weddings, vacation rentals and campgrounds around Shirley and Greers Ferry Lake.
